tips.promptEnhance: In Settings → General, turn on **Prompt enhancement**, then click the lightbulb in the composer to rewrite your prompt.
tips.pageLayout: In Settings → Appearance, drag items in **Page layout** to rearrange the workspace.
tips.rightSidebar: In the workspace **right sidebar**, open **Session details**, **Processes**, and the **Git diff panel**.
tips.leftSidebarOrder: In the workspace **left sidebar**, drag to reorder icons. The first icon is the default left panel.
tips.leftSidebarSplit: Drag a left-sidebar icon onto the left panel to show more than one left panel at once.
tips.composerAt: Type **@** in the composer to reference files, projects, sessions, commits, and instructions.
tips.fileSearch: Press **Ctrl+Shift+F** to search project contents from the file tree.
tips.kanban: Open **Kanban** in the top bar to review sessions and usage together.
tips.terminal: Open a **Terminal** in the workspace. Long-running Agent commands appear in that list too.
tips.runningTurn: While a turn is running, **queue** the next message or **insert into the current turn**.
tips.dockTabs: Drag workspace **tabs** to split the editor and view sessions, files, and previews side by side.
tips.settingsWindow: **Settings** opens in its own window, so the current workspace stays put.
